components.name: Orca Task Bridge (scripts/spec-orca.py)
components.responsibility: Translates 04_tasks.json into Orca Runs, Task DAGs with prerequisite bindings (--deps), parent-child hierarchies (--parent), and Checkpoint decision gates (gate-create).

components.name: Agent CLI Profile Registry
components.responsibility: Loads contracts/agent_profiles.json and provides canonical unattended execution flags, model flags, and reasoning effort flags for Claude, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor, and OpenCode.

components.name: Guarded Wave Scheduler
components.responsibility: Dispatches parallel-safe tasks into isolated child worktrees (--worktree new-child --setup run) and sequential subagents into the current worktree, binding them to Orca tasks.

components.name: Supervised Worker Event Loop
components.responsibility: Supervises active workers via orca check --wait, handles questions (ask/reply), captures worker_done completion payloads, and releases settled terminals.

components.name: Deterministic Gantt Generator (scripts/render-gantt.py)
components.responsibility: Reads 05_execution.json / 04_tasks.json timing intervals and deterministically generates, validates, and injects syntax-error-free Mermaid gantt charts into 05_execution.md.

components.name: Comprehensive Sidecar Validator
components.responsibility: Validates 00_state.json, 01_discovery.json, 02_requirements.json, 03_design.json, 04_tasks.json, 05_execution.json, and audit_findings.json against JSON schemas and performs 3-way traceability checks.

components.name: Budget & Quota Inspector
components.responsibility: Inspects available token/credit quotas, provider usage limits, or rate limit tiers, dynamically down-tiering non-critical tasks or deferring execution during cooldowns.

correctness_properties.description: The spec-family contract and agent_profiles.json define canonical unattended flags and model/effort mappings for all supported agents.
The spec-orca.py bridge script accurately translates 04_tasks.json dependencies, parents, and checkpoints into Orca tasks and decision gates.
Worker placement isolates parallel-safe tasks in child worktrees with --setup run, while sequential subagents run in the current worktree, respecting model and reasoning levels.
The coordinator supervises workers via check --wait, handles questions and heartbeats, verifies structured worker_done returns, and safely releases settled terminals.
spec-audit resolves reviewer fan-out via fanout.py, dispatches parallel reviewer terminals, and merges structured review_verdict payloads into CERTAIN/UNCERTAIN findings.
Execution timing from Orca telemetry syncs to 05_execution.md/05_execution.json, while non-Orca environments fall back gracefully to local sequential execution.
All spec phases generate and validate JSON sidecars, supporting 3-way in-memory traceability validation among requirements, design, and tasks.
Formal JSON Schemas in contracts/schemas/ enforce sidecar validity, and sidecars reside cleanly in the dedicated .specs/<slug>/sidecars/ directory.
The Gantt generator script deterministically derives, validates, and injects syntax-error-free Mermaid gantt charts into 05_execution.md on schedule updates.

The model-router.py and spec-orca.py scripts inspect available credits and provider quotas, dynamically down-tiering non-critical tasks to economical models or deferring execution when rate limits or quotas are exhausted.

current_technology_evidence.query: orchestration run-create, task-create, worker-start, check --wait, gate-create
current_technology_evidence.decision: Use Orca orchestration CLI as the primary multi-agent orchestration runtime, leveraging child worktrees, PTY management, and inter-agent mail.
Pass --dangerously-skip-permissions for implementers to eliminate interactive prompt freezes in unattended PTY sessions.
Pass --full-auto and -c model_reasoning_effort= to automate tool approvals and control reasoning budget.

dependency_security_evidence.result: Standard Python standard-library / optional jsonschema package; no external network runtime required.
